snippet.title: Anant Express – Official Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The haunting begins on a set date. Are you ready to board the most cursed train ride ever?

Anant Express 🚂 is a psychological horror game set on a mysterious Indian train haunted by anomalies, entities, and the unknown.

The date is revealed... but what awaits you between the stations is far from ordinary.
Supernatural horrors, cursed passengers, and questions of reality await in this immersive indie experience.
